introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to ZokaiHub. By using our service, you agree to these terms and our privacy policy. Please read them carefully before proceeding.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.intro: We collect the following information to provide you with personalized fashion recommendations:

items.photos: Photos you upload to your digital closet
items.usage: App usage data and interaction patterns

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.content: Your data is used exclusively to power AI-driven style recommendations, organize your digital wardrobe, and connect you with the fashion community. We never sell your personal information to third parties.

items.access: Access your personal data at any time
items.delete: Request deletion of your account and data
items.export: Export your data in a portable format
items.optOut: Opt out of non-essential data collection

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: We use trusted third-party services for authentication (Google, Apple) and analytics. These services have their own privacy policies that govern how they handle your data.

ageRequirement.title: Age Requirement
ageRequirement.content: You must be at least 13 years old to use ZokaiHub. If you are under 13, please do not create an account.

changes.title: Changes to This Agreement
changes.content: We may update this agreement from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or in-app notification.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about these terms or our privacy practices, please contact us at privacy@zokaihub.com
